doc: Hand-checked landing-corridor zones (par 4 / 5 tee shots of the card set) in WGS84 [lon, lat]. Zone order is kept: later zones override earlier ones (tee_strategy.lie_at); unzoned = rough. footprint_ll = the mapped corridor (145-345 yds along the tee line, +/-65 yds): the hand map only covers that area. Traced by eye in the corridor frame (frame: render.Frame, UTM, tee / aim of the card set from the package; yard frame x right, y = -along) on NAIP 2023 0.3 m with NAIP other years and 3DEP lidar canopy; never from a vision layer. Built by course_data/truth/corridor.py build from trace.py.
registration: none needed: traced directly on georeferenced NAIP (the corridor frame is exact)
